people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: The women sang to one another as they played, and said, “Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.”
translations.bsb: And as the women danced, they sang out: “Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands.”
translations.kjv: And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.
translations.asv: And the women sang one to another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, And David his ten thousands.
